statement: Define cnt(s) = the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(nums) for which there exists a non-negative integer c such that nums[i] = s + c * space. The function returns a result r and: (a) there is an index i with 0 <= i < len(nums) such that nums[i] = r; (b) for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), cnt(r) >= cnt(nums[i]); (c) for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), if cnt(nums[i]) = cnt(r) then r <= nums[i].
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000; 1 <= space <= 1000000000.
